ubs-352234.text:
Are you a Java expert who enjoys solving complex technical challenges in elegant ways? Are you excited by modern frameworks, tools and engineering practices? Do you want to build scalable technology that improves loan execution and processing?
We are looking for a Java Developer to:
• design, develop and enhance digital products and technology services, delivering technical analysis, specifications, component designs, code, tests, documentation and other engineering artifacts
• build scalable service-layer and API solutions in collaboration with business analysts, engineers, database developers and quality assurance professionals
• apply software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD and DevOps, and manage CI/CD and release cycles to continuously improve our products and services
• build observability into solutions, monitor production health, resolve incidents and address the root causes of risks and issues to maintain secure, reliable and compliant solutions
• troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing software and APIs, while evaluating new technologies and reusing strategic platforms and standards with long-term sustainability in mind
• work in agile, multidisciplinary teams, advocate for client needs, share technical knowledge, support hiring and mentor junior team members

ubs-353262.text:
Are you excited by the opportunity to build and own production-grade Python solutions that power a strategic front office platform? Do you enjoy solving complex problems across technology, data, and business domains? Are you interested in applying AI at scale to improve platform performance, monitoring, and automation?
We are looking for a QIS Platform Analyst to:
• design, develop, and maintain production-grade Python applications that support platform analytics, controls, monitoring, workflow automation, and business-critical processes
• build scalable and resilient data pipelines, validation frameworks, and analytical services used in live production environments, applying strong software engineering practices including testing, code reviews, documentation, and maintainability
• use Python to develop AI and machine learning capabilities, including intelligent monitoring, anomaly detection, signal identification, and automated control processes
• enhance platform resilience through automated checks, dashboards, observability frameworks, and proactive investigation and resolution of production issues
• solve complex problems across systems, data, processes, and business logic while driving long-term, scalable improvements rather than short-term fixes
• partner closely with Trading, Structuring, Model Quants, and Technology teams to deliver robust solutions, support platform evolution, and onboard new strategies, datasets, and capabilities

ubs-349216.text:
Are you passionate about protecting the firm from undue Cyber and technology risk? Do you enjoy working within collaborative team to improve the risk posture of the organization? Are you exceptionally good at building relationships and influencing outcomes?
We’re looking for a CORC Cyber Risk Controller to:
• collaborate with GCOO colleagues to address short-term and long-term strategic Cyber Risk remediation
• formulate Cyber Risk opinions, including emerging and Third-Party Cyber Risks
• provide credible and actionable challenge and assurance to our First Line of Defense colleagues on the design and operational effectiveness of cyber security and technology controls across UBS globally
• ensure that information security and Cyber-related risks are understood, owned, and managed
• provide review and challenge to our businesses on projects, emerging technologies, new initiatives, technology processes, risk, incidents and controls
• perform data analysis, deep dive investigations, controls testing, drive specific risk initiatives as required and in support of activities such as deep dive reviews, and risk assessments
• understand and comply with key regulatory and external audit requirements and ensure appropriate treatment and attention is provided by the risk owner
• support the GCORC Risk Management team with relevant data from Cyber Risk team for their reporting delivered to higher management

ubs-352596.text:
Do you understand the critical importance of safeguarding sensitive data across diverse channels and environments? Are you passionate about identifying risks, strengthening controls, and driving effective data protection practices across a global organization?
We're looking for someone like this who can:
• execute against run the bank activities such as data breach investigation and complaint review
• respond to field inquiries regarding data privacy and data loss prevention
• analyze data leakage incidents in Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tool to identify improvements to rule sets, shepherd rule changes through program governance and work with technology on implementation
• work with stakeholders in Global Wealth Management US (GWM US) Divisional Information Security Office (DISO), Central Information Security Office, Technical Information Security Office, Data Protection Legal, Data Protection Office, Cyber Security Operations, vendors and business to manage potential data breaches front to back ensuring compliance with Reg S/P timelines
• act as SME on Data Loss Prevention (DLP) system policy and operation
• act as SME on Reg S/P and identity theft prevention program regulation
• education of field / clients of recommended steps safeguards in response to reports of suspected identity theft

ubs-347047.text:
Are you keen on working in world class Cyber Security Operations Center for one of the best Swiss private banks?
Do you have related experience and are willing to take it further by learning how to defend an enterprise against cyber-attacks? Do you have the right attitude and are eager to join a multinational team of Cyber Security professionals?
We are looking for an Incident Response expert who will:
•respond to cyber security incidents covering all phases including identification, containment, and eradication
•act as engagement point for wider technology teams within Major Incident Management framework
•support and maintain response strategy to severe incidents and key attack scenarios
•maintain coordination and communication streams horizontally and vertically as part of major cyber related incident handling
•perform technical analysis and triaging as part of incident investigation and actively collaborate with Cyber Intelligence teams to ensure response capabilities are adequate to the threat
•enhance both technical and organizational controls to improve the security posture.
